title: Why 90% of retail traders still lose despite 100 YouTube tutorials
extracted_insight: Traders experience severe 'analysis paralysis' from mixing MACD, RSI, ICT order blocks, and Elliot Wave. The real bottleneck is lack of objective trade conviction, causing traders to exit winners too early and let losers run.

title: The FinTwit Echo Chamber: How social media hype lures retail into liquidity traps
extracted_insight: By the time a stock or crypto setup is trending on X or TikTok, retail buying volume represents exit liquidity for early callers. Retail traders desperately need tools that decode sentiment *before* it peaks.

title: Retail Trader Psychology in High-Volatility Regimes
extracted_insight: Survey of 1,200 active retail accounts revealed that 73% of losses occur due to revenge trading following a single stopped-out trade. Structured execution plans with pre-calculated invalidation levels cut account blow-ups by 58%.

title: Collective Intelligence vs Single Expert Bias in Market Forecasting
extracted_insight: Aggregating independent predictions across a distributed network of experienced traders consistently outperforms single celebrity market forecasters by dampening individual emotional biases.
